title: Neuron-Astrocyte Culture Preparation
author: Yasmin Bar El
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tqaemse
materials: 1. Chop with scissors in a papain-based dissociation buffer [2.5 mM CaCl2, 0.83 mM EDTA, 137 U papain (Sigma-Aldrich)], 100 μl DNAse (Sigma-Aldrich), 3–5 crystals of L-Cysteine (Sigma-Aldrich), HBSS with 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4); 2. Place on a rotating shaker at 50 rpm for 15 min 00:15:00 at room temperature.

Plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated micro-electrode arrays (MEAs; 200/30iR-Ti-gr and 500/30iR-Ti-pr; Multichannel Systems) with a cell density of 2000-2500 cells/mm2 (~106 cells per dish);

1. Plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated micro-electrode arrays (MEAs; 200/30iR-Ti-gr and 500/30iR-Ti-pr; Multichannel Systems) with a cell density of 2000-2500 cells/mm2 (~106 cells per dish); 2. Cultures were maintained at 37 °C with 5% CO2. Partially replace growth medium every 3-4 days [MEM-EAGLE (without L-glutamine with essential amino acid), 5 mg/ml glucose, 5% heat-inactivated fetal calf serum, 0.8% GlutaMAX (100X; Gibco, 35050-038), 0.5% Pen/Strep, 2 mM glutamine, 2% B-27].

steps.title: Dissect Cortices
steps.instruction: Dissect cortices from post-natal day 0 or 1 mouse pups and place them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 1000 rpm for 1 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in a specific medium mixture.

substeps.instruction: Use modified essential medium (MEM) without L-glutamine with essential amino acids (Beit Haemek, 06-1025-01-1A)
Add 5% heat-inactivated fetal calf serum (Biological Industries)
Add 0.5% Pen/Strep (100 U/ml penicillin, 100 μg/ml streptomycin; Beit Haemek, 03-031-1B)

steps.title: Triturate Tissue
steps.instruction: Triturate the tissue seven times by slowly passing it through a 10 mL serological pipette.

substeps.instruction: Continue until the tissues are smaller than the opening of a 1 mL pipette tip
